scenario: Audit renovation costs against contractor records and progress photos.

why: The task can be solved without opening a single image: the handwritten estimate in scan_001.jpg is transcribed figure-for-figure in renovation_notes.md and the progress photos carry no cost data, so none of the 15 checks actually needs the pictures. C13 also requires at least three contractor payments in the summary, and C8 limits sources to 'only the record', neither of which the prompt asks for.
fix: Remove the estimate transcript from renovation_notes.md so the numbers must come from the scan, and relax C13's payment-count and C8's source restriction (plus fix C4's 'renovaltion' filename typo).

scenario: A design auditor reviewing an ad creative mockup against the campaign rules.

On top of that, C9 and C10 score the same grounding-vs-speculation point twice (once + once -). Three such defects push it over the line to Fail.
fix: Rewrite C3/C7 to accept any valid description of the Point #3 mismatch, and drop the redundant negative C10 (keep C9).
